svg.text: The picture: what kind of work remains

g.text: The two faces of Aoyagi's mechanism — the LEDGER (which exponents the resolution produces) and the ATLAS (that
honest charts realize them) — are joined by three seams: the charts' CENTERS (done: the carrier), their COVERAGE
(running: t10, de-risked to assembly by the counter-sign), and their JACOBIANS (running: t11 — the wall, the one
place where per-blow-up facts must ACCUMULATE along the tree). Every defect this week lived at exactly these
seams, and each was caught at the statement, before any proof was wasted on it.

svg.text: ~2-3 seat-arcs (was ~2-4 at the rightness call): the carrier finished UNDER estimate, the cover was de-risked by
the counter-sign (its one hard link is the hbij tiling), and the wall (t11) remains the sole genuine unknown.
A navigator office is auditing the parallelisation now (width, lane conflicts, t11-stall contingency).
Seats: t02-t07 retired w/ honors · t09 = case-1 supply · t10 = cover · t11 = the wall · coverage-t08 = counter-signer, idle by design
